notes: Sepolia (chain 11155111) application contracts, in deployment dependency order. VerdictBurnVault is the permanent fee burn sink. VerdictOracle uses IMD Intake v2 through request, with the supplied asset, signer, action, price and zero configuration delay. $owner resolves to 0x397dacb1ee8e9a8ce5196988958f56bde0a0a312 and controls oracle configuration; it is also the VerdictMarkets treasury and guardian. Markets uses the approved fees and pool cap, with maxSettlerReward of 250000000000000000. Settler rewards come from each market's bounty, preserve the remaining oracle reserve, and are deducted before terminal bounty returns. Escalation is unrewarded; a zero settler reward preserves existing behavior. The creator allowlist starts enabled and is managed by the guardian.
